summary: Large golf club car park, quiet northern edge under trees, no homes.
reasons: Large car park, many cars parked

best_section.where: Northern edge of the Meiers Road golf club car park, under the trees beside the road verge

drivers.seclusion: Golf club car park between a main road and rail line; nearest mapped building is a non-dwelling 16 m away at the clubhouse end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed entry from the east; open bitumen and dirt strip along the north edge wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy road and railway just north; car park itself is quiet.
drivers.convention: Dozens of cars parked in the lot in the imagery.

flags: Mapped gates 88 m and 142 m away have a way round
sun_shade: Tree cover over the north strip, mostly shading the afternoon from the west and the morning from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the club locks the car park
